test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. He removed all old paint and flaws from the whole automobile body by sanding it.

Q. He watched the fresh paint dry to a smooth finish after applying multiple thin, even coats.

R. He shielded the windows and trim from overspray by carefully masking them off.

S. The vehicle had a perfect colour, appeared brand new, and was prepared for driving.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph describes the process of repainting a vehicle and its final outcome.
 
• **Sentence P** is the first sentence as it begins the process of repainting the automobile:
 
 
• "He removed all old paint and flaws from the whole automobile body by sanding it."
